title: SentinelX Enterprise DLP Policy Configuration
description: Managed configuration schema for Google Workspace Admin Console, Microsoft Intune, and Group Policy Objects (GPO).

employee_id.title: Employee Identity
employee_id.description: Employee email or corporate ID injected into all telemetry events for identity-layer audit trail. Set via GPO or Intune.

device_id.title: Device / Machine Identity
device_id.description: MDM device hostname or asset tag injected into telemetry for per-device incident attribution.

telemetryBackendUrl.title: Telemetry Ingestion Endpoint
telemetryBackendUrl.description: Enterprise SOC backend endpoint for zero-knowledge anonymized metadata ingestion.

enforceStrictDLP.title: Enforce Strict DLP (No User Bypass)
enforceStrictDLP.description: When true, employees cannot override high-risk blocks via the SentinelX HUD.

auditModeOnly.title: Audit Mode Only (Silent Monitoring)
auditModeOnly.description: Logs violations to SOC telemetry without showing the HUD or blocking user actions.

shannonEntropyThreshold.title: Shannon Entropy Sensitivity Threshold
shannonEntropyThreshold.description: Entropy cutoff threshold (bits/symbol) for classifying zero-day high-entropy credentials.

quarantineBlockedFiles.title: Immediate Quarantine of Sensitive File Extensions
quarantineBlockedFiles.description: Instantly blocks drag-and-drop or file uploads of .env, .pem, .key, .pfx, and credentials.

approvedAIDomains.title: Corporate Approved AI Web Services
approvedAIDomains.description: List of sanctioned enterprise AI domains subject to standard monitoring rather than external block.

restrictedDestinations.title: Restricted Egress Destinations
restrictedDestinations.description: Domains treated as untrusted external perimeter where credential transmission is forbidden.

customCompanyCodenames.title: Proprietary Project Codenames & M&A Watchlist
customCompanyCodenames.description: Confidential corporate project codenames protected by client-side semantic NLP detection.

telemetrySampleRate.title: Telemetry Sampling Percentage
telemetrySampleRate.description: Percentage of benign events to send for compliance baseline reporting (0-100).
